visual.general_description: Six grayscale axial chest CT slices arranged in two rows of three, labelled A to F.
visual.detailed_description: A 3 by 2 grid of axial chest CT images separated by white gutters, each with a printed letter at its upper left (A, B, C in the top row; D, E, F in the bottom row). Every slice shows the heart and mediastinum centrally, two dark lung fields and the chest wall. Panels A and B show scattered small opacities in both lungs; panels C and D show more extensive patchy opacities in the posterior and peripheral lungs; panel E shows fewer opacities than D; panel F shows mostly dark lung fields with only a few faint linear opacities. No other text, scale or markers are printed.

A thin rim of chest wall surrounds the lungs and the spine is at the bottom center. No other text is printed.

visual.general_description: Line chart of five laboratory series with horizontal drug-administration bars and arrows over a month/day axis.
visual.detailed_description: A wide line chart with a legend at the bottom listing five series: ALT, AST, LDH, CK and Ferr, each with its own marker and color. The horizontal axis prints month/day dates from 2/27 to 7/30 at weekly spacing; the vertical axis prints 0 to 1400 in steps of 200 with no axis title. In the upper part of the chart, horizontal colored bars carry printed drug labels: GC with the text 2mg/kg and a stepped-down thickness toward the right, HCQ and TAC, TOF, PE, PFD, CYC, IVIG and TCZ. Black downward arrows are placed under or on several of the bars. The five laboratory lines differ in shape. ALT is nearly flat, then rises briefly, then drops sharply and stays low with a slow decline. AST falls, rises briefly, then falls again and stays low. LDH declines gradually with a dip and a rebound, then declines again and rises slightly at its last point. CK falls early, stays low and flat, and rises slightly at its last point. Ferr falls steeply, rises briefly, falls again, then declines gradually.
